grantAccessDescriptionBoth: This CRM reads your mail and calendar so meetings and email threads show up on the right organization. It is read-only — nothing is ever sent on your behalf.
grantAccessDescriptionGoogle: This CRM reads your Gmail and Calendar so meetings and email threads show up on the right organization. It is read-only — nothing is ever sent on your behalf.

grantAccessPrivacyNotice: Only conversations with organizations in the CRM are stored. Personal mail is discarded without being saved.
heroSubtitle: Humans shouldn't be manually moving pipeline. The first agentic CRM experience — durable research agents that read your team's inbox, enrich organizations and clients, and create agentic workflows.
metaDescription: The first agentic CRM experience — durable research agents that read your inbox, keep every record current and book their own follow-ups.
noSignInMethodDescription: This CRM has no sign-in method configured, so nobody can get in — including you.
